title: Ship the metrics the buffer collected

blocks.text: A service records metric lines into a `MetricsBuffer`. Every ten seconds a shipper thread calls `drain()` and sends the list it gets back to the metrics collector. Since the last release the collector's graphs for this service are flat, though the shipper logs a shipment every ten seconds and the buffer never grows.
Finish `drain()` in `src/main/java/practice/MetricsBuffer.java`: it hands over the lines recorded since the last drain, and leaves the buffer collecting a new batch. About three lines.

cases.says: after a drain the buffer holds no lines, and lines recorded afterwards wait for the next drain
the list a drain returns holds the lines recorded before it, and only those

origin.section: A return Fixes Its Value Before finally Runs, but the Object Can Still Change

concepts: return passes a reference to the object, so finally that mutates the object (clear()) changes what the caller receives, while reassigning the variable does not.
